headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-4 on the top plays · Season: 8-42

entries.headline: Kazuma Okamoto stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kazuma Okamoto went 2-for-4 against Cristian Javier and the Houston Astros. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 0-for-2 with 2 BB against Andrew Alvarez and the Washington Nationals. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Jonathan Aranda came close
entries.story: Jonathan Aranda went 4-for-5 with 2 RBI against Michael Lorenzen and the Colorado Rockies. Closest call was a double in the 8th: "Jonathan Aranda doubles (19) on a sharp line drive to center fielder Cole Carrigg. Taylor Walls scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Junior Caminero connected
entries.story: Junior Caminero cashed. Facing Michael Lorenzen, he went deep in the 1st in his 1st at bat. The call: "Junior Caminero homers (31) on a fly ball to right center field. Jonathan Aranda scores." He added another later in the game. Final line: 2-for-5.

entries.headline: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stayed in the yard
entries.story: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. went 0-for-4 against Cristian Javier and the Houston Astros. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
